flowtitle.text: DME Intake: review UI prototype (M4 design source)

howto.text: Press Play on the top board. Sign in (any values) → Upload PDF → Choose PDF → wait for extraction → the review screen shows the NPI checksum error. Type 1234567893 into Provider NPI and Save → status turns Ready. The p.N chips jump the PDF preview.
